extDescription.message: Lets local agents (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Kav) drive tabs in this Chrome through the k-browser bridge on 127.0.0.1.

popupCodeHint.message: Get it in a terminal with

popupNote.message: Only tabs an agent opened itself are reported; your other tabs are never seen.

bgUnpaired.message: Run `k-browser pair` in a terminal and paste the code below

tagSdk.message: judged by the SDK from the observation log

noConfigured.message: No program is set up yet: run k-browser install.

allowListNote.message: Allow-list mode: the sites it may use are set in its file (allowedOrigins); the panel does not change them. This program cannot use JEV.

blockedNotList.message: Its blockedOrigins is not a list: fix its file in a terminal.

categoriesHint.message: Blocked site categories (✓ blocks the whole category; click to switch. Turning one off also removes sites you added by hand that are exactly the same as that category's):

otherSites.message: {0} more sites added by hand; the panel leaves them alone.

anyBlockNoJev.message: With any blocking, this program cannot use JEV (takes effect at once).

evalOffNote.message: eval: off (to turn it on, run k-browser client set {0} --eval on in a terminal)

settingsApply.message: Changes to blocking, screenshots and eval apply when this program restarts (or reconnects its k-browser MCP server).

decisionsExplain.message: While on, Kav records each judgement it makes in run_flow: kept only on this computer (~/.k-browser/decisions), redacted, for 30 days, for training site-specific models later. Takes effect from the next run_flow; turning it off does not delete what was recorded.

decisionsPurge.message: To delete it all, run k-browser decisions purge in a terminal.

backendOff.message: off (judgements go back to the agent)

problemCloud.message: No agreement to the current version: nothing is sent

problemKey.message: No JEV key: nothing is sent

problemConfig.message: The settings file cannot be read: Kav cannot use any model

jevLimited.message: These programs have site limits and cannot use JEV: {0}

noJevKey.message: No JEV key yet: import it in a terminal with k-browser model jev (the key never passes through the browser).

gap.message: Some updates did not arrive (the panel or the disk fell behind); what is shown may be incomplete. {0}

gapReconnect.message: Some updates did not arrive (the panel fell behind; it resyncs after reconnecting). {0}
